## What should change, and why?

Explain the correction, disagreement, or improvement.

## Sources or examples

Link primary sources for factual claims. Mark opinions as opinions.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/check_site.py` (or explained why I could not).
- [ ] I checked the affected page visually if I changed its layout.
- [ ] I preserved the article's perspective and did not add private information.
- [ ] I checked diagrams, document metadata, and this PR description for internal information or unreleased plans.
